title: On Satisfying the elders with one answer
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：satisfy　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 satisfy 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1975 the porter ① satisfied the elders with one answer twice over, and every visitor in the coast said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the porter ② satisfies the elders with one answer year after year without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ satisfy the elders with one answer at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ satisfied the elders with one answer before — a line in the journal for August 1969 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Satisfying the elders with one answer twice over, the porter said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the bag at the far cove, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ satisfy the conditions of the contract year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Satisfy the conditions of the contract at once and never mention it again.

By 1982 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the journal, and a new visitor from the next coast ⑧ satisfies the conditions of the contract twice over every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the cove, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ satisfied the elders with one answer again when nobody else would.

⑩ To satisfy the elders with one answer, my mother said in 1987, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the coast remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the coast forgets, somebody satisfies the elders with one answer year after year again and somebody must satisfy the elders with one answer twice over all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 使满意（一般过去式 satisfied the elders with one answer：1975 年挑夫头一回这样做，来回两遍）
B. v. 使满意（一般现在 satisfies the elders with one answer：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 使满意（不定式 to satisfy the elders with one answer：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 使满意（过去完成时 had satisfied the elders with one answer：1969 年八月的行记上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 使满意（动名词 satisfying the elders with one answer 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 满足（satisfy the conditions of the contract：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去满足满足合约上的那些条件）
G. v. 满足（satisfy the conditions of the contract：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 使满意（后段两处：新来的游客照例 satisfies the conditions of the contract，而母亲又一次 satisfied the elders with one answer）

answers.why: satisfy 意为“使满意”，1975 年挑夫来回两遍使满意一个答复就让长辈满意了，那是海岸里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 satisfied。
satisfy 意为“使满意”，自那以后挑夫年年地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 satisfies。
satisfy 意为“使满意”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯使满意一个答复就让长辈满意了”，此处为不定式 to satisfy the elders with one answer。
satisfy 意为“使满意”，行记里 八月 那行字说明早在 1982 年之前就有人使满意过，故用过去完成时 had satisfied。
satisfy 意为“使满意”，挑夫说“使满意一个答复就让长辈满意了这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 satisfying the elders with one answer 作主语。
satisfy 意为“满足”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去满足满足合约上的那些条件”，should ever 之后用原形 satisfy the conditions of the contract。
satisfy 意为“满足”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻满足满足合约上的那些条件（satisfy the conditions of the contract at once），以后再也不要提起。
satisfy 意为“使满意”，新来的游客每个星期都照例满足满足合约上的那些条件，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 satisfies。
satisfy 意为“使满意”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次来回两遍使满意一个答复就让长辈满意了，用一般过去式 satisfied 叙述。
satisfy 意为“使满意”，结尾那句是母亲 1987 年的话：要使满意一个答复就让长辈满意了，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和海岸记住的那一件。

多年以后，挑夫仍年年地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（satisfies the elders with one answer）

早在 1969 年就有人使满意一个答复就让长辈满意了，八月那天行记上的一行字就是证据。（had satisfied the elders with one answer）
挑夫说过，来回两遍使满意一个答复就让长辈满意了这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（satisfying the elders with one answer 作主语）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 satisfy 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1975 the porter satisfied the elders with one answer twice over, and nobody in the coast forgot it.
Even now the porter satisfies the elders with one answer year after year whenever the coast asks.
Satisfying the elders with one answer twice over, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever satisfy the conditions of the contract year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new visitor from the next coast satisfies the conditions of the contract twice over every week, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother satisfied the elders with one answer again, and the coast remembered that half.
